_comment_studio_config: The studio default: which bundle each DCC version uses. Lives in the remote repository, next to hosts/. The localiser keeps a last-known-good copy for offline launches.
_comment_hosts: hosts[<host>][<dcc series>]. The series is the DCC version the entry applies to. Bundles are found at <remote_repository>/hosts/<host>/<bundle_version>. Comments are only allowed as top-level _comment keys.
_comment_bundle_version: Plain numbers for standard builds (1.0.0). A '+tag' suffix marks a variant such as 1.0.0+dev. IDs are opaque; selection is by exact match, never by ordering. null means no bundle is selected: the pipeline does not load for that DCC version.
